status: Dormant Node service adapter implemented; handler/browser/worker integration remains unimplemented and unauthorized hosted

adapter_contract.scope: Fresh single service-side callback invocation only; no public server endpoint, default bypass flag, database control activation or work-recovery capability.
adapter_contract.before_work: Validate server actor/kind, generate a fresh operation UUID, issue one begin RPC and validate its exact schema/identity/token/safe integer revision. Error-bearing, missing, foreign or malformed reply means no work and no finish attempt. An uncertain begin can leave a durable active receipt.
adapter_contract.after_work: Successful callback means its caller has independently confirmed the operation-specific result. Issue one completed finish and validate exact operation/state. Lost or invalid completion may already have committed; no second finish, uncertainty rewrite, result return or replay.
adapter_contract.failed_work: Issue at most one needs_review finish with the known receipt. If marking fails, leave active work counted. Surface a generic safe error; never expose private/provider text, raw causes or receipts.
adapter_contract.unfinished_work: No automatic timeout, expiry, cleanup or early completion. Callback/process failure cannot establish that external work stopped.
adapter_contract.privilege_boundary: Service client is used only for begin/finish RPCs and is not passed to callbacks. Each handler must continue using its existing caller-RLS client and current authorization/source checks for private data. Admission is not student access.
adapter_contract.refusal_classification: A callback may resolve a confirmed negative domain result only when that handler can prove work is settled. Never convert an unknown network/provider/save outcome to a confirmed result. Present generic errors without treating them as permission/source proof.

Establish expected viewer, current edit/source permission and fixed server operation kind before admission.
Keep existing byte-copy/fingerprint/scan/registration/source receipt checks and caller-RLS data writes.
Keep a confirmed queued summary separate from completed summary processing. Do not clear an interval merely because an enqueue was attempted.
Preserve strict atomic source/student/revision/section and current-access checks on the caller client.
Review pre-admission authorization and confirmed-refusal versus uncertainty handling before exposing a route that can create retained holds.
Only a validated existing atomic save receipt may be treated as a confirmed save; no sequential fallback.
Prepare a Deno-compatible adapter/protocol with the same loss/mismatch boundaries; do not introduce an app-source import outside the worker release package.
Use actual job claim/actor/source identity and keep verified source admission and guarded completion.
Hold/count outstanding model/storage requests independently; no automatic retry, cancellation or unobserved drain claim.
